text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Ev'ryone's so trendy and
gorgeous.
They're all dressed like real
city girls.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Well,
I guess I can't linger here forever.
I'd
better start head'n back...

text_block_list.name: Shop Assistant
text_block_list.text:
Did anything in particular catch your
eye?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(What should I say? At this rate, I'm not
gonna
make it back in time for train'n...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I know this clerk wants t'help, but I've
gotta get
outta here!)

text_block_list.name: Shop Assistant
text_block_list.text:
The skirt on display over there is quite
popular at the moment. In fact, we might
sell out, so you
should buy it while you
can. ♪

text_block_list.name: Shop Assistant
text_block_list.text: Oh, yes. It's even been featured in fashion magazines... and I just know it would suit you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A skirt featured in fashion magazines...
Um, could
you tell me more 'bout it?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin is so entranced by the
clerk's sales
pitch that she ends up
skipping training.
